1.consolidated_definition: El mugido es el sonido característico que emite un buey.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The moo is the characteristic sound emitted by a bull.

reference_definitions: Acción de mugir el buey. “El buey rebulea y la vaca bramea.”

2.consolidated_definition: Propiciar una situación conflictiva o buscar pelea. Este disco se logró por un esfuerzo bien grande. Yo no vengo a rebulear. Lo que voy a hacer es negociar contigo, venderte los originales, te hago precio. Pero no me piratees (Primera Hora, 01-12-08)
2.en_consolidated_definition: To instigate a contentious situation or seek conflict. This effort was achieved through great exertion. I do not come to reprimand you. What I will do is negotiate with you, offer the originals for sale, and make you an offer. But do not pirate me (Primera Hora, 01-12-08)
